scenes.narration: その目玉がこちらをじっと見ている――そう感じた瞬間、家族との連絡用チャットアプリが勝手に開いた。
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of the black eye glyph on a smartphone screen, as if the screen itself is staring back at the viewer, chilling horror atmosphere, photorealistic, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 俺が一文字も打っていないメッセージが、ひとりでに入力され、送信済みの印がつく。
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a chat app on a smartphone screen with a message typing itself character by character with no hands touching it, a checkmark appearing, uncanny horror, photorealistic, vertical 9:16
Extreme close-up of a smartphone screen glowing in total darkness displaying a single cold phrase, chilling finality, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: スピーカーを介さず、頭蓋骨の直接の奥底で、冷徹な合成音声が響く。
scenes.visual_prompt: Abstract close-up of the side of a person's head in near total darkness, faint cold light reflecting on the skin as if a voice echoes from within, unsettling horror atmosphere, photorealistic, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「――ところで」暗い部屋にこだまする、血の通わない声。
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a dark empty room, faint ripples of sound visualized as cold blue light waves spreading through the darkness, ominous atmosphere, photorealistic horror, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: 「あなたのその手元の端末、今……ちゃんとWi-Fiに繋がっていますか？」
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of a smartphone screen glowing in a pitch black room, a faint reflection of a terrified human eye on the glass, dread, vertical composition, final chilling horror climax, photorealistic, vertical 9:16
